name: Maine Lobster 1.5lb (Soft Shell)
short_description:
There’s nothing fresher than locally sourced, live Maine lobster caught in our backyard – the Scarborough, Maine bay. Get your taste of Maine with our 1.5 lb. soft shell lobsters.

Please Note: Soft Shell lobsters are not available for shipping. Lobsters must be picked up or delivered locally.
